description: Central cross-device artifact registry, viewer, and lightweight applet host for pi session documents and browser-viewable media.

scripts.reports:example: node scripts/make-report.mjs --kind narrative --body examples/reports/narrative-body.html --meta examples/reports/narrative-meta.json --references examples/reports/gl-references.json --out examples/reports/demo-narrative.html && node scripts/make-report.mjs --kind detailed --body examples/reports/detailed-body.html --meta examples/reports/detailed-meta.json --out examples/reports/demo-detailed.html && node scripts/make-report.mjs --kind combined --body examples/reports/narrative-body.html --evidence examples/reports/detailed-body.html --meta examples/reports/combined-meta.json --references examples/reports/gl-references.json --out examples/reports/demo-combined.html
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run webcheck && npm run coverage && npm run smoke

name: @centerforagenticai/pi-artifacts
